component-metadata.description:
Normalization of selected columns. It is possible to choose from several normalization methods (median, quantile, loessF). If you do not want to normalize data select "no normalization".
If a dataset should be normalized in subsets, user can specify the subsets of columns that should be normalized together under Subsets design. Design should be provided in format "A, A, B, B". The order of categories is kept as per their occurence in the design field.
